title: Sesame Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Ground chicken sautéed with soy, ginger and scallions, served in crisp butter lettuce leaves.
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, honey, garlic and ginger.
Cook the ground chicken until browned, then pour over the sauce and toss to coat.
Fill the lettuce leaves with the chicken mixture, carrots, scallions and sesame seeds.
notes: Butter lettuce cups swap out the calorie-dense wrap while keeping the meal genuinely interactive to eat.
